statement: Remove the ACTIVE row that the transaction coordinator writes on sql_transaction_participants at the first write to each table, at its single producer (enlistParticipantsOwned and the overlap that waits for it in executeWriteStatement). The manifest on sql_transactions, appended by exact compare-and-set before any participant request, remains the admitted participant set; participant rows begin with the PREPARE evidence. The participant's in-memory transition to ACTIVE when its BEGIN succeeds stays and is witnessed: a participant already begun is never begun again, also after a read promoted to a write, after an AUTHORITATIVE enlistment (locking read, global index, bindTransactionToPartition) and after the participant lost its session, so earlier staged writes are never silently dropped by a second BEGIN. Recovery, release, decision and settlement behaviour are unchanged, and no answer changes except one field in one state: the participant list of a transaction restored from rows and held before its first authoritative refresh no longer names participants that were never asked to prepare (evidence/design-note.md, transition record item 9; lead ruling 2026-11-28). What the removal leaves without a caller is deleted in the same change (evidence/design-note.md, section C6). Expected effect: a write transaction waits for up to P fewer sequential consensus rounds (new_order 19 -> 14, payment 17 -> 13) and submits P fewer proposals and CDC obligations (new_order 36 -> 31 proposals, payment 30 -> 26).

constraints.statement: The exact OPEN-row manifest compare-and-set stays the first durable act for every participant and precedes its BEGIN, QUERY or write; recovery derives the admitted set from the manifest alone and reads a missing participant row as a member without evidence.

Every participant's PREPARED row with prepared_digest, prepare_index and prepare_term is durably persisted before a COMMIT decision is recorded (sealed constraints preserve-two-phase-decision-protocol and preserve-cas-and-prepared-evidence-authority stay in force).

A participant already begun in a transaction is never begun again: the in-memory participant transition to ACTIVE is kept when its durable row is removed. Probe: guard properties one-begin-per-participant (repeated writes, a read promoted to a write, an AUTHORITATIVE enlistment followed by writes) and lost-session-not-reopened-by-begin (a real participant that lost its session refuses the next write; no second BEGIN; the transaction rolls back with nothing applied).

The ACTIVE write is deleted at its one producer; no flag, mode, alias, elided placeholder write or second path is introduced, and everything the removal leaves without a caller is deleted in the same change (design-note.md C6). Readers of durable rows keep accepting participant rows that earlier builds wrote.

The status = PREPARED write on sql_transactions is not removed by this quest (lead ruling 2026-11-28): it is a recorded proposal for the TX1 owner in solve/quests/transaction-redundant-progress-writes/evidence/deferred-prepared-status-removal.md, with its precondition (a refused decision write is retried idempotently or resolved by the same node), change B1 and conditions C2-C4.

Every changed assertion of another quest's witness, probe or receipt (evidence/seals-and-contracts.md section 5: the fast-path guard priority-1 and priority-2 checks and their witness tests, the tx-metadata purpose counts, the participant-set overlap and Finding 1B witnesses, the telemetry export's pinned mutation sequence fixture, the es6-owner-safety receipt binding) is named in a supersession finding in this quest with the original record; closed records stay untouched.

Landing condition (review L3): the quest transaction-path-telemetry-export has landed, and this quest's red measurement, witnesses and supersession of that quest's pinned mutation sequence fixture are re-measured on that base before implementation starts.

Landing conditions (review L1, L2): the TX1 witnesses test/raft/raft-rs-backend/transaction-leg-a-three-replica.test.js (A5) and test/integration/transaction-coordinator-restart.integration.test.js, red on main at ab347e962, are repaired by their owner first and a native three-replica crash-boundary run passes on this quest's candidate; the closed fast-path guard's pre-existing red (metric 2 at ab347e962) is repaired by its owner first.
The recovery witnesses in test/query/transaction-redundant-progress-writes-recovery.test.js and the guard's preservation properties stay green and are not weakened.
Every source attempt requires independent verification newer than the attempt, recorded with verifier subagent:<id>, before landing.
